prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: painted storybook. Texture family: warm lightly toothy cream drawing-paper grain with faint graphite smudge and softly uneven pigment pickup. Palette: warm ivory and cream paper, soft graphite and sepia-gray pencil, muted sage and moss greens, pale straw ochre, faded powder blue, restrained brick-red accents, all low-saturation and softly weathered. Line treatment: loose hand-drawn graphite contours with visible pressure variation, gentle broken hatching, softened construction marks, sparse crosshatching, and lightly rubbed shadow edges; colored pencil remains subordinate to the pencil drawing. Lighting: soft diffuse daylight with gentle warm highlights, shallow pencil-cast shadows, and no dramatic cinematic contrast. Avoid: no photorealism, no glossy 3D CGI, no anime or manga language, no vector-clean outlines, no neon palette, no heavy inked comic rendering, no hyper-detailed medical illustration, no modern HUD graphics, no hard digital gradients, no copied characters or exact composition from the style reference, and no visible watermarks, text, labels or typography inside the imagery. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. The attached operator_style_reference is style-only: use its palette, material texture, line language and lighting as inspiration for this original neutral anchor. Do not copy its subject, composition, text, logo, person, or recognizable layout.
